preserved_fields.description_medium: In April 2025, HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. said he planned to direct the CDC to stop recommending fluoridation of public drinking water and said HHS would convene a task force to reassess the issue. At that point CDC's recommendation had not yet been removed. Major dental and public-health organizations continued to support community fluoridation at recommended levels.

title: Trump Moved to Strip Gulf Wildlife Protections in the Name of 'National Security'
description_short: Trump Moved to Strip Gulf Wildlife Protections in the Name of 'National Security'
description_medium: Trump moved to revoke protections for endangered species in the Gulf of Mexico by invoking national-security logic around drilling and energy supply. This is one of his favorite frauds: use a grave word like security to excuse a grubby policy that mainly serves extraction interests. The species still die the same way, only now the paperwork pretends patriotism did it.

title: Trump Pardons Adam Kidan Three Days After $2,600 Donation to Ryan Mackenzie Leadership PAC
description_short: Trump Pardons Adam Kidan Three Days After $2,600 Donation to Ryan Mackenzie Leadership PAC
description_medium: Federal records and contemporaneous reporting show that Adam Kidan donated $2,600 to Rep. Ryan Mackenzie's leadership PAC on June 30, 2026 and received a full presidential pardon on July 3. DOJ's clemency record lists Kidan's 2006 restitution order as $21,701,015.45. The timing is factual; available evidence does not establish that Mackenzie sought the pardon or that the contribution caused it.
